thread:
Nora Li: FYI CostAuditBot spiked an "allocation gap" for customer=astral-ai; ~$31,200 in April is still mapped to shared-training-pool. can infra confirm if this was multi-tenant training or a misattributed upload? :eyes:
CostAuditBot: Alert: Allocation gap detected. Unattributed GPU spend for Apr-2026: $31,200. Primary SKU: nvidia-h100 (preemptible). Export: https://billing.console/exports/astral-gap-apr.csv
Marco Alvarez: looking — trace shows a training job batch-run-20260421 that used the shared-training pool because tenant_tag failed validation on upload. upload service returned 202 but dropped tags for >3GB datasets.
Priya Singh: that upload service is mine. i pushed a patch last week for multipart handling, but the tag middleware was async and had a race. i'll backfill tags where possible and re-run the allocation job.
Tobias Meyer: finance will need line-item ids and the original request ids to file with the cloud vendor (reseller). can infra produce a CSV with lineItemId, usageStart, usageEnd, instanceId, request_id?
Nora Li: yes please include whether cost was preemptible vs reserved. finance prefers separate columns so we can propose a partial credit for preemptible time.
Marco Alvarez: here's the bq query i used to surface the gap (billing table alias cb):
```
SELECT
  cb.invoice_month,
  IFNULL(cb.labels.tenant,'UNMAPPED') as tenant,
  cb.sku_description,
  SUM(cb.cost) as total_cost
FROM `company_billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_*` cb
WHERE cb.invoice_month = '2026-04'
  AND LOWER(cb.sku_description) LIKE '%h100%'
  AND cb.labels.tenant IS NULL
GROUP BY invoice_month, tenant, sku_description
ORDER BY total_cost DESC;
```
Priya Singh: i'll run a retro-tag script against job metadata and S3 object tags. estimate ~42% of the gap can be auto-mapped. i'll drop the CSV to /shared/finance-temp/astral-apr-retro.csv when ready.
CostAuditBot: Note: billing export snapshot 2026-05-04T07:12:00Z. Suggestion: open vendor case with lineItemIds and request reallocation; create internal charge transfer for remaining unallocated amount.
Tobias Meyer: finance pre-approves a provisional charge transfer of up to $18k to Astral team pending vendor response and manager sign-off. final approval needs product manager + legal sign-off if reseller contract involved.
Nora Li: can we add a short-term guardrail: block >100 H100 preemptible hours per customer without tenant tag, and alert #billing-alerts + eng-infra? want to prevent repeats.
Marco Alvarez: added a guard in the upload service to reject datasets >1GB without tenant tag and opened PR: https://git.internal/redwood/upload-service/pull/215
Priya Singh: uploaded retro CSV: https://files.internal/shared/finance-temp/astral-apr-retro.csv. includes request_ids and instance_ids. noted rows where preemptible hours were charged.
Nora Li: thanks — i'll draft the vendor case text and include the CSV. will update this thread with the support case number and the charge transfer journal entry once posted. :thumbsup:
